title: Vehicle inspection appointment reminder
description: Remind customers of a property or vehicle inspection for their insurance claim, with date, time and address. Utility template.
notes: Give a time window and ask for a reply to reschedule; Meta likes clear transactional actions tied to an existing claim.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your inspection for claim {{claim_no}} is scheduled for *{{date}}* between {{window}} at {{address}}. Please make sure someone is available.
